name: XverConceptMapProperties
title: FHIR Cross-Version ConceptMap Properties CodeSystem
description: Properties for FHIR Cross-Version ConceptMaps. These properties are used to include additional details about the relationship between source and target elements in a ConceptMap that maps between different versions of FHIR.

concept.definition: Boolean value that indicates whether the mapping target is an extracted or derived value from the source element, rather than a direct mapping. This property is used to indicate that the target element is not a direct representation of the source element, but rather a value that has been extracted or derived from it.
Boolean value that indicates whether the cardinality of the source element collapses when mapped to the target element. E.g., 0..* string values can be concatenated into a single string value.
String value that provides guidance or notes about how the mapping should be interpreted or applied.
Boolean value that indicates whether the represented element mapping cannot be safely reprented without omitting a mandatory code element.
Boolean value that indicates whether the concept mapping is considered unsafe or potentially problematic.
